info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchant Acquiring Facility Management API
info.description: This API facilitates the management of merchant acquiring facilities, allowing businesses to update their card processing configurations efficiently. With the PATCH operation, users can modify specific attributes of existing acquisition facilities, ensuring they meet operational requirements. Typical consumers include merchants and payment processors, who benefit from the ability to adapt their services dynamically. Use cases range from adjusting transaction limits to updating service agreements, streamlining the payment processing ecosystem.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific Merchant Acquiring Facility identified by its unique ID. Make sure to provide the necessary data in the request to successfully modify the existing information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the merchant acquiring facility details for the specified MER-800045. Ensure that the provided JSON matches the schema definitions to successfully apply the updates.
